snippet.title: Toontown: The Grindworks - Pocket Pranks Trailer
snippet.description:
The Grindworks Team is pleased to announce our first major update Pocket Pranks coming May 3rd, 2025! This content update adds a variety of new items, rooms, and secrets to be found! 

Download the game: https://itsevan.itch.io/toontown-the-grindworks
Join the discussion: https://discord.gg/nHvtN5uYnC
